label: text
text: A Chinese steward on the s.s. "Halvard" pleaded guilty at the Kowloon Magistracy yesterday to charges of having in his possession 300 cigarettes on which no duty had been paid and attempting to bribe a constable.

text: An old lady being shown, round Rochester Cathedral by one of the vergers, arrived at a tablet in the nave in memory of Charles Dickens. "Oh," she said, "I never knew that Dickens was killed here." "He wasn't mad," replied the verger, "but why do you ask?" "Why, it says, 'This tablet was erected by his executors.'
